Hey, under the snake’s head.  
9. The sun burns the snake,  
Hey, and from the snake’s mouth drips venom.

Hey, and the magic is at his doorstep.

Hey, and the magic is already on the table for him.

Hey, sister to him with a shot glass:  
13. – Oh, here, brother, is some of this beer,  
Hey, that I drank myself.

Hey, he rolled off on the horse.  
15. On the black horse,  
Hey, on the golden saddle.  
16. – Sell, sister, my horse,  
Hey, save me, young one!  
17. Sell the horse and the saddle,  
Hey, save me, my heart!  
18. – I did not enchant you  
Hey, for me to save you!  
19. Oh, in the field there is a little pitcher,  
Hey, there is cold water.  
20. There a girl was drawing water,  
Hey, she was talking to a Cossack:  
21. – Oh, Cossack, little Cossack,

If I fall into the sea – I won’t live,  
If I return home,  
I will live – I will get married.', "1. A mother gave her daughter  
To a stranger's side,

That she should not return for seven years.

And came back in a year,  
She transformed  
Into a gray cuckoo,  
And sat in a cherry orchard.

Oh, when it starts to dawn,  
Oh, will she not come out,  
Oh, will she not hear  
My dear mother?  
4. Oh, the mother came out of the house  
And stood on the threshold;  
Oh, how she remembered  
That she had given her daughter away, –  
Thin tears poured down.  
5. – Take, son, the gun  
And shoot the cuckoo:  
Oh, let her not call,  
Let her not disturb the garden,  
Let her not parch my little heart.  
6. Oh, the son took the gun

Came to him  
And began to speak:  
7. |: – Don’t shoot me, brother, –

I am your sister. :|

Oh, with small,

10. – Have I, my mother,  
Eaten too much bread and salt from you,  
That you gave me away  
And tied me to the world, –  
To someone I did not want.  
11. – No, my daughter,  
You have not eaten too much bread and salt from me,  
But I gave you away  
And tied you to the world, –  
To someone I myself wished for.", '1. Oh, do not bend, dear pear tree,

6. – Oh, I do not want payment, brother,

7. Oh, we had only one mother,

18. – Oh, stop, brother, do not be afraid,

24. Decorated with flowers,
